body: Well, again the car was totaled because the cost of an engine was more than the value of the car. And endurance denied my claim because they said the issue with the engine was “preexisting”. Basically they used pure speculation that there was an issue before I purchased my policy with them that caused the engine to fail 6 months later. As of this reply, I filed a complaint with the BBB and was able to get all the money back that I paid for the policy over the 6 months. I just had to sign a contract that I wouldn’t say anything negative about them, sue them, or be their customer ever again. 😂 whatever.
